insight: In Vitest integration tests against Postgres, vi.useFakeTimers() must be scoped as vi.useFakeTimers({toFake:["Date"]}). Faking setTimeout deadlocks the postgres.js driver and every query times out at 5s.

vi.mock is hoisted above import statements, so its factory cannot reference an imported helper (ReferenceError: Cannot access __vi_import__ before initialization). Write the factory inline as async () => (await import("./helpers/x")).factory().

Importing Next server modules in Vitest fails with "This module cannot be imported from a Client Component module" because server-only resolves through the browser condition. Alias server-only to an empty stub in vitest config resolve.alias.

Tailwind v4 cannot @apply one custom component class from another (@apply btn inside .btn-primary fails with "Cannot apply unknown utility class"). Declare shared rules once across a selector list instead.

GitHub's OAuth workflow-scope push restriction checks the NET effect of a push on .github/workflows/, not each intermediate commit. A push whose earlier commits add a workflow file but whose final tree removes it is accepted without workflow scope, so no history rewrite is needed to unblock it.

In Tailwind v4, shared component classes written directly in globals.css are UNLAYERED and therefore beat @layer utilities. `class="input pl-10"` silently resolved to the .input padding, not pl-10, hiding input text under prefix icons across 7 inputs. Wrap the component block in @layer components so utilities win. Guarded by test/globals-css.test.ts.

Dayflow leave actions re-selected a row, checked status===pending, then wrote by id alone. The select-then-write gap let an admin decision and an employee withdrawal interleave, stranding `leave` attendance rows that permanently block check-in. Carry the status predicate into the UPDATE/DELETE and treat 0 returned rows as losing the race. checkInAction already did this correctly with onConflictDoNothing — follow that pattern.

A sequential test of a check-then-write race passes with AND without the fix, because the pre-check catches the sequential case. Use Promise.all to fire both paths concurrently, then verify by reverting the guard and confirming the test actually fails.

Another agent session works in /Volumes/NIT-SSD/Development/odoo-dayflow concurrently and switches branches mid-run (observed Divyank -> deepak -> codex/deepak-review during one /ship). Commits can land on whatever branch is checked out at the time. Verify `git branch --show-current` immediately before every commit, and push with an explicit refspec (git push -u origin <branch>) rather than a bare push.

Putting `npm run db:migrate && next build` in vercel.json buildCommand makes a missing DATABASE_URL fail the BUILD rather than deploying a site that 500s on every authenticated route. Verified on odoo-dayflow: deploy errored with `DATABASE_URL is required to run migrations` and nothing was published.
Vercel build runs db:migrate first; provision/connect Neon so DATABASE_URL exists before deployment. The stable production alias is odoo-dayflow-steel.vercel.app.
